_comment_rewrites: Only /blog/* falls back to the SPA shell: posts published between deploys have no prerendered file yet, and the client fetches them at runtime. Every other route is prerendered to dist/<route>/index.html, which Vercel resolves from the filesystem before rewrites run. The previous blanket catch-all sent *every* unmatched URL to /index.html, so any typo returned HTTP 200 with the full homepage — unlimited URLs serving duplicate content and never a real 404. With no matching rewrite, Vercel now serves dist/404.html with a genuine 404 status.
